block.services.description.ceramic.1: Transform your vehicle with our premium ceramic coating service. Our advanced nano-ceramic technology creates an invisible shield that bonds to your paint at a molecular level, providing unmatched protection and a stunning, mirror-like finish that lasts for years.
block.services.card.benefit.ceramic.desc: Creates a permanent bond with your vehicle's paint, forming a protective layer that shields against UV rays, oxidation, bird droppings, tree sap, and environmental contaminants. This molecular-level protection prevents paint degradation and maintains your car's factory finish.

Blocks harmful ultraviolet radiation that causes paint to fade, oxidize, and lose its luster over time. Our ceramic coating acts as sunscreen for your car, preserving the vibrant color and preventing the chalky, dull appearance that comes with sun damage.

Enhances paint depth and clarity with a stunning, glass-like finish that makes colors pop. The coating amplifies your vehicle's natural beauty, creating a showroom shine that turns heads wherever you go. Your car will look like it just rolled off the assembly line.

Unlike traditional waxes that last weeks or sealants that last months, our ceramic coating provides 5+ years of protection with proper maintenance. This permanent solution means fewer reapplications and consistent protection throughout the years.

block.services.card.benefit.house.descri: Reduce cooling costs by blocking heat and UV rays, making your home more energy efficient.

Prevents fading of furniture, flooring, and décor by filtering harmful sunlight.
block.services.card.benefit.commercial.d: Reduces HVAC strain by maintaining cooler interior temperatures.
Creates a comfortable environment that boosts employee satisfaction and productivity.

Improves curb appeal with a uniform, modern look that reinforces your branding image.
block.services.card.benefit.ppf.descript: Protects your paint from rock chips, scratches, and road debris.
Adds a sleek, high-gloss layer for that freshly-detailed look every day.

Keeps your vehicle looking new longer, maintaining resale value.

refund.1.title: Refund Policy @ Tints At Home
refund.1.description: At Tints At Home, our priority is to ensure your satisfaction with every window tint installation, whether for vehicles or residences. Below is our refund policy:
refund.2.title: Valid Refund Requests
refund.2.description: Refund requests will be accepted only in the following cases: The service was not performed due to reasons attributable to our team, the client canceled at least 24 hours before the scheduled appointment or there was a verifiable error in the shade or type of film installed that differed from what was requested.
refund.3.title: Refunds Do Not Apply If:
refund.3.description: The client was not available at the agreed time and place (no show). The service was carried out as agreed, but the client changed their mind after installation. There was pre-existing damage to the glass that affected the installation and was not reported before the service. The cancellation was within 24 hours of the scheduled appointment.
refund.4.title: Refund Method
refund.4.description: Approved refunds will be processed using the same payment method used for the purchase. Refunds may take 5 to 10 business days depending on the bank or payment provider.

refund.5.description: Email us at Tintsathome.miami@gmail.com or call 954-676-4480 with your full name, order or appointment number, and the reason for your request.
